description: Fetches the status and results of a run that was still "running" when a SiteVerdict data tool returned (by runId and tool name). Does not start a new run and costs nothing extra.
name: get_run_results

dryRun.description: true = built-in SAMPLE data from this server, NOT a real lookup

items.description: Result records (trimmed for context). Records often carry a recordType discriminator.

status.description: Apify run status: SUCCEEDED, RUNNING, FAILED, TIMED-OUT, ABORTED, or DRY-RUN

usageTotalUsd.description: Cost of the run on the caller's Apify account, when Apify reports it

sampleData.description: true = the Actor returned fictional sample rows (e.g. no credentials configured); never present as real

status.description: "running" = still working; call get_run_results with run.runId later

truncated.description: true = more records exist than are included here (see datasetUrl)

title: Get results of an earlier data-tool run
